metadata.title: Rustic Country Portrait with Canine Companion

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man with curly blonde hair sitting outdoors against a weathered wooden structure, accompanied by a white fluffy dog. The image features a desaturated, slightly warm-toned color palette and a prominent, wide, italicized sans-serif typeface positioned across the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with dog in the lower foreground
Text overlaying the subject's chest area to bridge foreground and background
Muted earth tones in clothing and environment contrasting with the white dog
Soft, natural lighting creating a relaxed, approachable mood
coreInvariants: Desaturated color grading with a slight yellow/green tint

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Man is centered, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame; dog is positioned in the bottom center foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's direct gaze and the bright white fur of the dog.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the man's face, move down to the bold text, and settle on the dog in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Darker shadows to the left of the man provide depth and contrast for his hair.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted sage green and slate blue (clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and black (shadows and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with a compressed value range, giving a vintage film-like quality.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, denim blues, and desaturated greens

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'd' and 'b' feature mirrored circular bowls
The 's' has a shallow, wide curve

treatment.outline: Thin white outer glow/stroke for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact; no secondary fonts.
graphicDevices: Subtle outer glow on text to separate it from the clothing texture

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, yet approachable 2000s aesthetic.
Very similar geometric structure and horizontal presence.
Provides the same square-ish, wide feel if softened.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with curly blonde hair wearing a layered grey and blue t-shirt, sitting on a wooden bench next to a white fluffy dog. The background is a weathered wooden wall with soft natural lighting and a desaturated, warm-toned color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of lowercase text across the center of the image using an extra-wide, bold, italicized sans-serif font in black with a very subtle white outer halo.

verificationChecks: Is the text lowercase and extra-wide?
Is the color palette desaturated and rustic?
Is the dog positioned in the lower center foreground?
Does the man have a direct, soft gaze?

adjustableVariables: Exact placement of the text (higher or lower on the torso)
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or logos
Ensure the text is not a direct copy of existing brand typography

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between man and dog

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the man's face
Verify the '2000s country' color grading is present
Ensure the dog's fur looks soft and natural
Confirm the font is wide and italicized
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rustic outdoor portrait of a male subject and a pet with centered, extra-wide italicized lowercase typography in a desaturated earth-tone palette.
